title: Would love some feedback
author: Zulugod94
selftext: Been building this game for me and some friends to play on a Friday, kinda surprise for one of favorite Halo 3 forge maps. Original game mode is "Zombies" so 1 player vs survivors, killed players join infected until no one is left. Second game mode I made since I enjoyed the traversal so much is a run and gun. Hydra rule on kids so, kill an aline 2 spawn in its place. Movements is inspired heavily by Titanfall 2, game rules and stuff by halo 3 forge infected game mode. Obviously I'm no pro, just looking to make things better before we all have some fun on it.

comments.author: Felmeric
comments.body: All those dark areas look to really dark. Like I don't know if that's what you are going for but I could see nothing in any of those areas. Good for some horror jump scares but any actual combat in those would be painful. Other than that the movement looks fun. The gunfire and enemy hit effects seem a bit basic but it could just be the darkness and music making them hard to read.
